name: doctoreto-mcp

tools.name: dt_suggest
tools.description:
Search-box suggestions: matching doctors (with hash id), speciality slugs, service tags and centers.

    Use it to turn a free phrase into the slugs and ids the other tools need, e.g. 'قلب' -> speciality
    'cardiologist' for dt_search_doctors. Doctors match by name text, so for a speciality prefer the returned
    speciality slug over the doctor list. Next: dt_search_doctors, dt_doctor or dt_center.

query.description: What the user typed, in Persian: a doctor's name, a speciality or a symptom, e.g. 'قلب' or 'پرآذران'.
query.title: Query

city_id.description: Numeric city id from dt_cities to rank one city first, e.g. 2200 (Tehran).
city_id.title: City Id

tools.name: dt_search_doctors
tools.description:
Search doctors on Doctoreto by city, speciality, neighborhood, service tag, name, gender, insurance and visit type.

    Each card has the hash `id` (input of dt_doctor), visit types offered, the office visit fee when listed,
    office areas, the earliest free slot over all services (Tehran time, with the Jalali date), review count,
    recommend percent and bookings. Online consultation prices are not in the cards (the list's phone price
    differs from the booking page): call dt_doctor for prices. near_lat/near_lon narrow to doctors near a point.
    Next: dt_doctor -> dt_free_slots.

city.description: City slug from dt_cities, e.g. 'tehran'. Omit for the whole country.
city.title: City

speciality.description: Speciality slug from dt_specialities or dt_suggest, e.g. 'cardiologist'.
speciality.title: Speciality

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood slug from dt_neighborhoods, with city only, e.g. 'pasdaran'.
neighborhood.title: Neighborhood

service_tag.description: Service or symptom tag slug from dt_suggest, e.g. 'echocardiography'.
service_tag.title: Service Tag

name.description: Doctor's name in Persian (part is enough), e.g. 'پرآذران'.
name.title: Name

gender.description: Only male or only female doctors.
gender.title: Gender

insurance_ids.description: Insurance ids from dt_insurances (any of them), e.g. [1]. Few doctors list insurances.
insurance_ids.title: Insurance Ids

visit_type.description: Only doctors offering this visit: office (in person), phone, text (chat), video, instant (on-call phone/text now), any_online.
visit_type.title: Visit Type

has_free_slot.description: Only doctors with a free appointment slot.
has_free_slot.title: Has Free Slot

sort.description: default = site ranking (sponsored first), popular = review count and recommend rate, earliest = soonest free slot, most_booked = most bookings.
sort.title: Sort

near_lat.description: Latitude of a point in Iran, e.g. 35.7575.
near_lat.title: Near Lat

near_lon.description: Longitude of a point in Iran, e.g. 51.4100.
near_lon.title: Near Lon

tools.name: dt_specialities
tools.description:
List medical, paramedical and dental specialities with the slug dt_search_doctors needs.

    `level` is specialist, subspecialist, fellowship or general; `parent` is the broader speciality
    (interventional cardiology -> cardiologist). About 100 entries. Next: dt_search_doctors(speciality=slug).

query.description: Part of the name in Persian or the slug, e.g. 'قلب' or 'cardio'. Omit for all.
query.title: Query

tools.name: dt_cities
tools.description:
Find a city's slug (for search filters) and numeric id (for dt_suggest).

    Without arguments returns the main cities first. With `speciality` returns only cities that have doctors
    of it, with the doctor count (main cities only; a search may still find doctors elsewhere).
    Next: dt_search_doctors(city=slug) or dt_neighborhoods.

query.description: Part of the city name in Persian or the slug, e.g. 'شیراز'.
query.title: Query

speciality.description: Only cities that have doctors of this speciality, with counts, e.g. 'cardiologist'.
speciality.title: Speciality

tools.name: dt_neighborhoods
tools.description:
Neighborhoods of a city (most doctors first) and nearby cities, each with a doctor count.

    Some entries are district groupings (منطقه 3, غرب) that work as filters too. Use a slug as
    dt_search_doctors(city=..., neighborhood=slug); suggest a nearby city when the user's city has few doctors.

speciality.description: Count only doctors of this speciality, e.g. 'cardiologist'.
speciality.title: Speciality

query.description: Part of the neighborhood name in Persian or slug, e.g. 'پاسداران'.
query.title: Query

tools.name: dt_insurances
tools.description:
List basic and supplementary insurers with the ids dt_search_doctors(insurance_ids=...) takes.

    About 84 insurers. Few doctors list insurances, so an insurance filter narrows a search a lot; centers list
    theirs in dt_center.

query.description: Part of the insurer's name in Persian, e.g. 'تامین' or 'آتیه'.
query.title: Query

tools.name: dt_doctor
tools.description:
A doctor's profile with every bookable service, its price in Toman and its next free time.

    `services[]` lists each office and online visit (phone, text, video, instant) with `consultation_id`
    (input of dt_free_slots), `fee` (the full price: for an office visit the fee paid at the office, for
    online visits the online price), `pay_online_now` (charged when booking; usually 0 for office visits),
    the office address and coordinates, and `next_free` (Tehran time). Also the about text, review summary
    (count, recommend percent, 1-5 averages per category), office waiting time and treated conditions.
    Booking needs an SMS login on the site: give the user `url`. Next: dt_free_slots, dt_reviews.

doctor.description: Doctor hash id from a search ('xqbEWZ') or the doctor's page URL ('https://doctoreto.com/doctor/dr-kambiz-parazaran/xqbEWZ'). The slug alone cannot be resolved.
doctor.title: Doctor

tools.name: dt_free_slots
tools.description:
Free appointment times of one service (office visit, phone/video call, clinic offer, lab admission).

    Returns only days with free times: date, English weekday, Jalali date and the free start times
    (HH:MM, Tehran local; for phone/video the call start). Times already past today are dropped.
    `bookable_until` is the last day the doctor has opened (often about 30 days ahead). Text consultations
    usually have no time slots. Booking needs an SMS login on doctoreto.com: give the user the page URL.

consultation_id.description: Consultation id of one service, from dt_doctor services[], dt_center services[] or dt_offer variants[], e.g. 1943.
consultation_id.title: Consultation Id

start_date.description: First day, Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD; default today (Tehran), e.g. '2026-10-14'.
start_date.title: Start Date

days.description: Number of days to check from start_date.
days.title: Days

tools.name: dt_reviews
tools.description:
Patient reviews in the site's order (doctors and centers newest first, offers oldest first): stars 1-5,
    recommends or not, text, chosen labels, visit type, reason for the visit, office waiting time, date
    (Gregorian Tehran day and Jalali) and the doctor's reply.

    Reviewer names are never returned. There is no sort or filter upstream: to find low ratings, page through
    (pages = total / limit). The summary (count, recommend percent, category averages) is in dt_doctor.

of.description: Whose reviews: a doctor, a center or a clinic offer.
of.title: Of

id.description: Hash id or page URL of the doctor, center or offer, e.g. 'xqbEWZ' or 'https://doctoreto.com/center/raz-shiraz-lap/YNrrOb'.
id.title: Id

tools.name: dt_search_centers
tools.description:
Find hospitals, clinics, infirmaries, laboratories, imaging centers and pharmacies with filters.

    Each card has the hash `id` (input of dt_center), kind, state/private, 24h flag, address, coordinates,
    review count and recommend percent, doctor count and whether it takes online bookings. With near_lat and
    near_lon it searches a square around the point (map search) and sorts by distance; dense areas return only
    part of the centers as cards and count the rest in `more_in_area`. Insurance filters have no effect
    upstream: check `insurances` in dt_center. Next: dt_center, dt_reviews(of='center').

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood slug from dt_neighborhoods, with city only, e.g. 'pasdaran'.
neighborhood.title: Neighborhood

speciality.description: Department / speciality slug from dt_specialities, e.g. 'ophthalmologist'.
speciality.title: Speciality

service_tag.description: Service tag slug from dt_suggest, e.g. 'mri'.
service_tag.title: Service Tag

name.description: Part of the center's name in Persian, e.g. 'قلب'.
name.title: Name

open_24h.description: Only centers open around the clock (pharmacies, hospitals).
open_24h.title: Open 24H

online_lab_admission.description: Only laboratories that take online admission bookings.
online_lab_admission.title: Online Lab Admission

near_lat.description: Latitude of a point in Iran, e.g. 35.7575.
near_lat.title: Near Lat

near_lon.description: Longitude of a point in Iran, e.g. 51.4100.
near_lon.title: Near Lon

radius_km.description: With near_lat/near_lon: half-width of the square searched, in km.
radius_km.title: Radius Km

limit.description: Centers per page (the API pages by 20).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: dt_center
tools.description:
A center's page: address, coordinates, departments, services, accepted insurances, attributes, opening
    hours, lab admission rules, bookable services with `consultation_id` (for dt_free_slots) and its doctors
    (hash ids for dt_doctor, with each doctor's earliest free slot).

    Doctor private offices (type office) have no center page: use dt_doctor for them. Booking needs an SMS
    login on the site: give the user `url`. Next: dt_free_slots, dt_doctor, dt_reviews(of='center').

center.description: Center hash id from a search ('YNrrOb') or its page URL ('https://doctoreto.com/center/raz-shiraz-lap/YNrrOb').
center.title: Center

doctors.description: How many of its doctors to list (0 = none).
doctors.title: Doctors

tools.name: dt_health_articles
tools.description:
Search Doctoreto's health magazine (about 5,000 articles) for background on a condition, test or treatment.

    Returns title, link, publish date and a summary; set text_chars to read the articles. General information
    only, not medical advice: for a diagnosis book a doctor (dt_search_doctors).

query.description: Disease, test, drug or treatment in Persian, e.g. 'فشار خون' or 'آزمایش تیروئید'.
query.title: Query

text_chars.description: Characters of article text to include per article; 0 = summary only.
text_chars.title: Text Chars

tools.name: dt_search_offers
tools.description:
Search Doctoreto clinic offers: fixed-price procedures and packages (ultrasound, echo, laser, dental,
    check-ups) sold by doctors and centers.

    Each card has the price and price after discount (Toman), what is paid online (`pay_online`: the deposit
    when `payment` is deposit_online, the rest at the place), provider doctor, place, earliest free time,
    star rating and the default `consultation_id` for dt_free_slots. Unknown sort upstream: compare prices
    yourself. Next: dt_offer, dt_free_slots, dt_reviews(of='offer').

anyOf.description: Doctor hash id from a search ('xqbEWZ') or the doctor's page URL ('https://doctoreto.com/doctor/dr-kambiz-parazaran/xqbEWZ'). The slug alone cannot be resolved.

doctor.description: Only offers of this doctor (hash id or page URL).
doctor.title: Doctor

center.description: Only offers at this place (hash id), e.g. 'ZWpOLy'.
center.title: Center

limit.description: Offers to return from the page (the API pages by about 40).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: dt_offer
tools.description:
One clinic offer in full: price, discount, deposit, who performs it and where, description, terms,
    capacity, expiry, rating, and its bookable variants with `consultation_id` for dt_free_slots.

    Booking and payment need an SMS login on the site: give the user `url`.

offer.description: Offer hash id ('ArraJa'), numeric id ('129311') or page URL ('https://doctoreto.com/offer/ArraJa').
offer.title: Offer

instructions:
Unofficial, read-only access to Doctoreto (doctoreto.com), an Iranian doctor booking site: office visits,
phone / text / video consultations, hospitals, clinics, laboratories, pharmacies and fixed-price clinic
offers. Nothing here can log in, book, pay or post reviews: booking needs an SMS login on the site, so
finish by giving the user the page `url` (doctoreto.com/doctor/<slug>/<id>) with the chosen time.

Doctor workflow:
1. Names to slugs: dt_suggest (free phrase -> doctors, speciality slugs, service tags, centers),
   dt_specialities, dt_cities (slug, numeric id), dt_neighborhoods (with doctor counts), dt_insurances.
2. Search: dt_search_doctors(city, speciality, neighborhood, name, gender, insurance_ids, visit_type,
   has_free_slot, sort='earliest' for the soonest slot, 'popular' or 'most_booked').
3. One doctor: dt_doctor (services with consultation_id, prices, office address, next free time, review
   summary), dt_reviews(of='doctor').
4. Times: dt_free_slots(consultation_id, start_date, days) -> free HH:MM times per day.
5. Hand over: tell the user the doctor, service, price, date and time, and the doctor's `url` to book.
Centers: dt_search_centers (type, city, 24h, state/private, online lab admission; near_lat/near_lon for a
map search) -> dt_center (hours, insurances, bookable services, doctors) -> dt_free_slots.
Clinic offers (fixed-price procedures such as ultrasound, laser, check-ups): dt_search_offers -> dt_offer.
Background reading on a condition: dt_health_articles (not medical advice).

Conventions: every price is Toman. For an office visit `fee` is the visit fee paid at the office and
`pay_online_now` what is charged when booking (usually 0); for phone/text/video `fee` is the online price.
A null fee means the doctor lists none. Use dt_doctor for online prices: search cards leave them out.
Dates in are Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD (convert Jalali first: 1405-07-22 = 2026-10-14); times are Tehran
local (no offset); Jalali dates are given next to Gregorian ones. Doctors, centers and offers are
identified by a 6-character hash id (xqbEWZ) or their page URL; slugs alone cannot be resolved, so search
by Persian name. Persian queries match best. Reviewer names are never returned; do not ask for them.
